title: Chapter 1451 - 3: One Hundred Thousand Years (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1451 - 3: One Hundred Thousand Years (Part 2)

Chapter 1451 - 3: One Hundred Thousand Years (Part 2)

"I know this, I know this."

The Dragon Stone Lord immediately said.

"Then Dragon Stone won't disturb Lord Galaxy."

The Dragon Stone Lord said cautiously.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Next, he needs to complete the test of his first trial, purifying the Golden Moon dimension.

"Lord Galaxy, then I'll take my leave as well."

The shopkeeper of Time-Space Shop did not dare to linger.

When unaware of Lin Yuan's true power, the shopkeeper of Time-Space Shop dared to stand by.

But having witnessed Lin Yuan's actions and the rumored Galaxy Lord, the shopkeeper of Time-Space Shop suddenly felt immense pressure, no longer daring to continue the conversation with Lin Yuan.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan glanced at the shopkeeper of Time-Space Shop.

Quickly.

The two Lords disappeared.

"Golden Moon dimension..."

Lin Yuan turned to look at the Golden Moon dimension, and a vast spiritual power immediately enveloped it. Before beginning to purify the dimensional space, Lin Yuan certainly needed to understand the

situation of this dimension.

The empty dimensional gap region.

The figure of the Dragon Stone Lord appeared, and next to him, the figure of the shopkeeper of Time-Space Shop emerged.

"Time-Space, what exactly is Lord Galaxy's origin? Such power..." the Dragon Stone Lord couldn't help but ask.

Initially, when polluted by the lingering thoughts of the Returning Ruins Lord, the Dragon Stone Lord spent a significant cost to meet a certain Legendary Lord.

But the other party didn't intend to intervene; the pollution of the Returning Ruins Lord's lingering thoughts was something ordinary Legendary Lords were unwilling to touch.

However, Lin Yuan spent merely a few days to mostly eradicate it.

This level of power is definitely not that of a common Legendary Lord. "Lord Galaxy, He..."

Even the shopkeeper of Time-Space Shop felt puzzled; when Lin Yuan acted in the Wanwei time-space, he displayed methods at the level of a Legendary Lord, but that was in the future.

As for the present time-space, he is not a Legendary Lord; otherwise, he couldn't have been forced out of the future self by the Blood Sea Lord.

Just now...

Effortlessly lifting the Dragon Stone Lord and easily eradicating the lingering thoughts of the Returning Ruins Lord that no Legendary Lord dared to touch?

This terrifying power probably belongs to the strong among the Legendary Lords.

"In short, remember. never offend Lord Galaxy."

Unable to understand, the shopkeeper of Time-Space Shop just responded perfunctorily to the Dragon Stone Lord.

"Even if I have the courage, I wouldn't dare offend Lord Galaxy..."

The Dragon Stone Lord shrank his head.

He personally faced a part of the force displayed by Lin Yuan when he acted, the kind of oppressive feeling beyond comprehension likely to be unforgettable for a lifetime.

Golden Moon dimension.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, carefully experiencing every detail of this top-notch dimensional space.

Unlike the Chaos Void and Milky Way dimension, the origin Dao of

this dimensional space is named 'Golden Moon' Origin Dao, possessing both utmost firmness and utmost yin characteristics.

"A decent origin Dao."

Lin Yuan slightly nodded, at his level, a few glances at an ordinary origin Dao are enough to understand.

Against-Heaven's Understanding combined with the life height of a Lord greatly reduces the usefulness of ordinary top-level dimensional spaces for Lin Yuan.

"Why does the Supreme Rule Dao will want me to purify this

dimensional space?"

Lin Yuan didn't immediately start the 'purification' method but fell into brief contemplation.

At present, it seems this dimensional space has nothing special, the

dimensional origin Dao is rare, but across the vast dimensional gaps,

countless special origin Daos exist unknown.

The Golden Moon Origin Dao is not particularly outstanding.

"Never mind better to nurify it soon"

After sensing for a while and noticing nothing unusual, Lin Yuan began

to operate the 'purification' method.

The 'purification' method originates from the Supreme Rule Dao will, simultaneously appearing in Lin Yuan's mind with the test content of

his first trial.

Buzz buzz buzz- As the 'purification' method operated, an invisible aura began to permeate the depths of the Golden Moon dimension

time-space.

This invisible aura didn't possess any corrosive characteristics but continuously spread until it encompassed the entire Golden Moon

dimension.

"According to the 'purification method' information, it only needs to

be maintained for a hundred years."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The specific content of his 'endless trials' first test is-

'Purify' the Golden Moon dimension for a hundred years.

In fact, the difficulty of this trial is not great.

The only thing that needs to be resolved is the Dragon Stone Lord.

The Dragon Stone Lord's power is close to the extreme of the Second Layer Lord.

Not too strong.

Even if his state is chaotic and special, one can wait for him to regain clarity and attempt a transaction.

After all, there's no time limit on this trial's test.

Even if it isn't a monstrous lord like Lin Yuan, but an ordinary Time

Lord.

Completing this ordeal isn't difficult.

It's just a matter of being a little later.

Even if he doesn't establish a clear agreement with the Dragon Stone

Lord, he can wait until the Dragon Stone Lord is driven completely insane by the lingering thoughts of the Returning Ruins Lord. According to the Dragon Stone Lord's condition, at most, after a few

dozen great destruction cycles, he won't even be able to maintain the basic 'occasional clarity!

At time, it's estimated that he'll rush out of the Golden Mo

Dimension in madness.

Rumbling.

With the passage of time.

The purification method continuously operated.

Ninety years later, Lin Yuan keenly noticed that threads of black aura

were being driven out by the purification method.

"These auras?"

Lin Yuan observed the threads of black aura.

The black aura emitted an essence completely opposite, even

diametrically opposed, to the infinite dimensional planes.

"This aura can lead to the irreversible destruction of dimensional space, with no so-called rebirth..."

Lin Yuan's expression was slightly solemn.

The destruction and rebirth of dimensional space is the operational

law of the vast dimensional planes.

Whereas irreversible destruction means no rebirth, so-called destruction is absolute destruction.

This obviously violates the operational laws of the Supreme Rule Dao's

will.

"I see."

Lin Yuan's expression was thoughtful.

The so-called 'infinite tribulation' path of transcendence essentially

drives lords to resolve anything that violates the operational laws of the Supreme Rule Dao.

Buzzing--the black aura continuously seeped out, but finally, in the ninety-ninth year, the seeping black aura quickly diminished. By the hundredth year, no matter how Lin Yuan operated the 'purification' method, he couldn't drive out any thread of black aura.

"It's over."

Seeing this, Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Clearly, the black aura present within the Golden Moon Dimension

had been completely purified.

However, the first ordeal required purification for a hundred years, so

he still needed to wait for the hundredth year to pass to be considered as having overcome this ordeal.

Boom!

The will of the Supreme Rule Dao descended, and Lin Yuan

immediately knew he had passed the first ordeal.

In the next moment.

A mysterious force poured into Lin Yuan's body.

Under the nourishment of this force, Lin Yuan's physical, spiritual,

and mental will slowly improved.

"Hmm?"

A few breaths later, this improvement stopped.

"Is this the benefit of passing the 'infinite tribulation"?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The 'infinite tribulation' path of transcendence became the most

well-known for reasons beyond its clear targets.

More importantly, after overcoming each ordeal, one can immediately

receive 'feedback!

Which means an increase in power.

"It's average."

Lin Yuan assessed the changes in his strength before and after and

concluded.

Passing the first ordeal had only a minimal impact on his strength growth.

But Lin Yuan wasn't surprised by this.

First, because he only passed the first ordeal of the 'infinite

tribulation!

It's considered the easiest ordeal. The improvement shouldn't be significant. Secondly, Lin Yuan's starting point was already immensely strong.

His inherent power was so vast that minor improvements were

difficult to notice.

"Take it slow."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If one ordeal doesn't provide a significant boost, then what about ten,

a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand, or even a billion ordeals? The quantitative change leads to a qualitative change, not to mention the trials of the Second Layer, the trials of the Third Layer, which

provide far more enhancement for a lord than those of the First Layer. "The second ordeal.."

After completing the first ordeal, Lin Yuan immediately began preparing for the next, the second ordeal.

With his power, he could pass any ordeal before the third stage

without any suspense.

And he had the 'World-Breaking Origin Force' as a fail-safe method.

And so.

Time passed quickly.

In the blink of an eye, ten thousand years had gone by.
